capabilities: Visualize vault-wide tasks in a 5-quadrant Eisenhower matrix
Expand quadrants into a Kanban board with status columns
Read and write Obsidian Tasks syntax (tags, dates, priority, dependencies)
Filter tasks by tag, frontmatter property, and due date
Show task dependencies in a graph with prerequisites first
extras: iOS is untested (Android confirmed); touch drag is an experimental, off-by-default setting. The README documents known parser limits, e.g. text after Tasks metadata fields drops out of the card title.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see, triage, and edit tasks scattered across many notes by urgency and importance in one place.

relations.evidence: The plugin reads/writes standard Obsidian Tasks syntax
Collects tasks from every .md file in the vault (Dataview-like)

summary: Task board that aggregates tasks from across the vault into a 5-quadrant Eisenhower matrix with Kanban and dependency-graph views.
